requestPath: Frontend (Sports.jsx) -> /api/v1/matches/:id (or /api/live-scores) -> server/routes/live.js -> lib/canonicalMatchState.mjs -> lib/matchStateCache.mjs -> lib/eventPersistence.mjs -> lib/matchDetailFetcher.mjs

layers.description: Evaluates baseActiveMatch from liveMatches pool. If missing from live array, triggers asynchronous fallback hook to /api/v1/matches/:id.

layers.statusContract: Returns 200 with explicit eventStatus ('LIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'HISTORICAL', 'NO_LONGER_LIVE') or 404 for nonexistent IDs.

layers.status: Checked first for ultra-low latency live in-play matches.
Checked second for high-throughput distributed state.
Permanent immutable anchor for placed-bet matches and historical scorecards.
External provider scrape/feed fetcher when local state requires hydration.
